Item 1. Business

Overview. We are a global financial services firm offering a broad range of banking, markets and investment management products to corporate, institutional and individual clients across more than sixty countries, operating through several reportable business segments that together make up the majority of our consolidated net revenue each year, supported by a large technology and operations infrastructure built up over decades of continuous investment. Our client franchise spans large corporations, governments, institutional investors and individuals, and we compete for that business against both traditional financial institutions and newer technology-driven entrants across every region in which we operate.

Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our results are subject to significant credit, market, liquidity and operational risk across the economic cycle, and a deterioration in macroeconomic conditions, a sharp move in interest rates, or a disruption to our technology infrastructure could materially and adversely affect our financial condition and results of operations across one or more of our reportable segments. We are also subject to extensive regulation in every jurisdiction in which we operate, and changes to that regulatory environment could increase our compliance costs or constrain our activities.
